name: claude-auto-repo-setup
description: On session start and working-directory change, wires up local-only Claude conveniences in the current git repo: a CLAUDE.md pointing at an existing AGENTS.md, and individual symlinks into .claude/ for each skill under .github/skills and each agent under .github/agents. Skips repo skills whose names would shadow a built-in Claude Code skill. Idempotent, and adds everything to the repo's local git excludes so nothing is committed.
